# truenas_reporting_exporter (Resource)

Manages a TrueNAS reporting exporter (reporting.exporters): a destination that periodically receives reporting/metrics data. Only the GRAPHITE exporter type currently exists on TrueNAS (probed via reporting.exporters.exporter_schemas on both TrueNAS 25.10 and 26.0), so "attributes" exposes GRAPHITE's fields directly as a typed nested block rather than a free-form JSON document.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_reporting_exporter" "graphite" {
  name    = "graphite-primary"
  enabled = true

  attributes = {
    destination_ip   = "192.168.1.50"
    destination_port = 2003
    namespace        = "truenas"
    prefix           = "scale"
    update_every     = 10
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attributes` (Attributes) GRAPHITE exporter settings (the only exporter type TrueNAS currently supports). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this exporter is enabled and active.
- `name` (String) User defined name of the exporter configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric reporting exporter ID assigned by TrueNAS.

<a id="nestedatt--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes`

Required:

- `destination_ip` (String) IP address of the Graphite server.
- `destination_port` (Number) Port number of the Graphite server.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace to organize metrics under.

Optional:

- `buffer_on_failures` (Number) Number of updates to buffer when the Graphite server is unavailable. Defaults to 10.
- `matching_charts` (String) Pattern to match charts for export (supports wildcards). Defaults to "*".
- `prefix` (String) Prefix to prepend to all metric names. Defaults to "scale".
- `send_names_instead_of_ids` (Boolean) Whether to send human-readable names instead of internal IDs. Defaults to true.
- `update_every` (Number) Interval in seconds between metric updates. Defaults to 1.
